- Recovery zips are now xz-compressed and about half the size to download. On
  Linux and macOS this is automatic; on Windows the tool keeps building the
  older, larger zip unless you turn on xz in expert mode (it is slower there)
- New in expert mode / on the command line (`-xz`): force xz compression
- Package improvements that arrive through the package repo, no new build of
  this tool needed:
  - Android Auto now works on ROMs whose framework leaves the projection role
    unset (an overlay supplies it)
  - Google location, autofill and passkeys are wired up on AOSP-based ROMs that
    do not set those framework defaults themselves
  - Packages are smaller: Play now delivers the Google Play services modules on
    first setup instead of them being bundled
